title: The General: BISHOP NATHANYEL 🔥
segments: Thanks to the assistance and guidance of
Bishop Yawasop and Bishop Kana, Israel
United in Christ ministry was dedicated
to restoring the nation of Israel.
Bishop Nathaniel has set up schools all
across the globe, even in Ghana. He
engaged in debate with pastors, met with
dignitaries, also landed an interview
with Jason Whitlock, organized some of
the largest marches like the Barkley who
got a resume like Memphis milestone and
has prophetical series breaking down all
22 chapters of Revelations and the 12
tribes breakdown. Backwards. We did it
backwards, y'all. Backwards. Where
there's two words found in the word
revolutionary. Revolve as in change.
We're changing the minds of our people.
We're revoling against all the lies this
system has taught against us. The Bible
prophesies about
144,000 true revolutionaries.
And finally, my brother, be strong in
the Lord about his voice. His voice is
his voice.
